spans.s:
mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Abandoned, left.
E.
वर्ज्ज to abandon, क्त affix, and the vowel substituted.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Powerful, mighty, great, excellent.
2 Exceeding, much.
E.
ऊर्ज्ज to be strong, क्त aff.

f. (-ऊर्क्)
Strength, vigour.
E.
ऊर्ज to be strong, क्विप् aff.

r. 10th cl. (ऊर्जयति)
1 To be strong.
2 To live.

m. (-र्जः)
1 The month Kārttika, (Oct.-Nov.)
2 Effort, exertion.
3 Power, strength.
4 Breath, breathing.
5 Procreative power.
n. (-र्जं)
Water.
E.
ऊर्ज to live, क aff.

mfn. (-स्वान्-स्वती-स्वत्)
Strong, vigorous.
E.
ऊर्ज्ज and मतुप् affix, with स inserted.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Strong, powerful.
E.
ऊर्ज strength, वलच् affix, and स inserted.

mfn. (-स्वी-स्विनी-स्वि)
Very strong.
n. (-स्वि)
Speaking of any thing with disdain, (a figure of rhetoric.)
E.
ऊर्ज and विनि affix, स inserted.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Spirited, magnanimous.
E.
ऊर्ज्जित great, आश्रय receptacle.
